0022600216.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (7-2, 3rd in the West and 1st in the Northwest) arrive on a three-game winning streak and a 3-2 road record, while the Portland Trail Blazers (6-2, 5th in the West and 0.5 games behind the Thunder in the Northwest) are on a one-game losing streak. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Robert Williams III (rest), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 124-95 win in Oklahoma City on December 31.
